body:
Filing gate ④: the cross-repo child of the design parent #8346 (PDF / print documents, ruling B′ `6051470224`), and the release step that #24190 also waits on. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK`, at #8346's close-out reading. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, grade and `target:` are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat, in one PR on `.objectui-sha` and its regenerated manifest. That is the lane of the previous pin moves (#24134, #23720, #23691, #23392); #24134's PR #24144 is the shape to copy.

## Measured

Readings are on objectstack `origin/main` `93b4acb57e` and on objectui `origin/main`, deepened 400 commits. Every negative `git merge-base --is-ancestor` below has a control leg: the pin's own `~3` answers exit 0.

- `.objectui-sha` on `main` is `5e15928b4631a9dfd0d9bdd7282d1b746cdbaa68`, set by PR #24144 (`265ef64ba`) on 2026-10-17. objectui `main` is 62 commits past it, at tip `32b492b67`.
- These four objectui merges are **not** in the pin. Each is an ancestor of `32b492b67`:

| objectui commit | what it ships | waiting here |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `d637be321` (objectui PR #12921, objectui#12906) | a print record page draws the record's header actions beside Print, so ④'s "Generate PDF" is reachable | #8346 |
| `8523e81db` (objectui PR #12923, objectui#12915) | the read-only line-items table prints display text, not raw values | #8346 |
| `32b492b67` (objectui PR #12937, objectui#12924) | boolean and file line cells print in the session language | #8346 |
| `54e79f989` (objectui PR #12914, objectui#12854) | `record:line_items` hydrates an untyped column from the child field | #24190 |

- The objectstack half of the PDF chain is all on `main`: `PagePrintSchema` (#22158), the printable-block lint, the `service-print` Chromium driver (#22269), and the "generate PDF" action (#22270, PR #24194 → `d9a749bae0`). So, by the cross-repo rule, the chain reaches an installable build only when this pin moves.

## Done when

- `.objectui-sha` names a green objectui `main` commit that has all four commits above as ancestors. Green means its `commits/SHA/check-runs` show completed with no failure, read at the move.
- The committed manifest is regenerated (`pnpm objectui:build`, then `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`), and `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` passes.
- The Console Pin Gate's local equivalent is run as PR #24144 ran it, and its reading is in the PR body.
- ⛔ Not a release act: the Version Packages PR is not touched and no release workflow is dispatched.

## Grade (a suggestion; triage's call)

p1. Both waiting cards are p1 `target:v18`, and the maintainer's standing order, quoted on #8346 at `6204242035`, is 「发版本优先的都p1」 (with 「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」).

- The full open-issue enumeration (110 cards): 0 hits.
